title: Morning Brief — Saturday, 14 November 2026
description: Thousands more funded university places are confirmed under the new Australian Tertiary Education Commission, a Bowen Hills planning overhaul could fast-track up to 27,000 Brisbane homes, and the Gold Coast's Pan Pacific Masters Games close tonight with a ceremony headlined by The Potbelleez. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
